parts.text: 已拿到测试反馈的截图（21199.png）。我看到关键信息：测试环境显示的是**3 列**布局（说明我的修复已生效），但测试人员圈出的红框区域仍被判定为“间距过大”。需要精确分析截图中的像素细节：

tool_input.command:
Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Drawing
$src = "C:\Users\Administrator\.dsh\skills\zentao-analyzer\zentao_file_21199.png"
$img = [System.Drawing.Image]::FromFile($src)
Write-Output "原图: $($img.Width) x $($img.Height)"
# 裁剪红框区域并放大 2 倍
$rect = New-Object System.Drawing.Rectangle(470, 130, 900, 260)
$bmp = New-Object System.Drawing.Bitmap(900*2, 260*2)
$g = [System.Drawing.Graphics]::FromImage($bmp)
$g.InterpolationMode = 'HighQualityBicubic'
$g.DrawImage($img, (New-Object System.Drawing.Rectangle(0,0,1800,520)), $rect, 'Pixel')
$out = "C:\Users\Administrator\.dsh\skills\zentao-analyzer\crop_fields.png"
$bmp.Save($out, [System.Drawing.Imaging.ImageFormat]::Png)
$g.Dispose(); $bmp.Dispose(); $img.Dispose()
Write-Output "已裁剪: $out"
tool_input.description: Crop and zoom dialog field area
